author: TerritorialPvP
body:
Hello! My name is TerritorialPvP. I was banned for Aimbot Hacks on May 6th, 2014, at around 8pm. While I do admit I was hacking, and I completely agree I should have been banned, I feel that I have completely learned my lesson, and I would love to rejoin the community again :) If you agree with me, please do unban me, and if not thank you for reading my appeal.

- TerritorialPvP
